{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash -l

# Flux batch script (translated from PBS)

# PBS requested:
#   -N MURbui
#   -A UCSU0085
#   -q main@gusched01
#   -l select=1:ncpus=1:mpiprocs=1:mem=50GB:ngpus=1
#   -l walltime=00:10:00
#   -e build.err
#   -o build.out
#   (gpu_type=a100 is commented out)

flux alloc \
  -N 1 \
  -n 1 \
  -c 1 \
  --gpus=1 \
  --time=10m \
  --queue=main@gusched01 \
  bash -lc '

# Approximate PBS stdout/stderr file directives
exec >build.out 2>build.err

# NOTE: PBS -A UCSU0085 (account/project) has no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none for runtime, but accounting/charging/allocation association may be incorrect.

# NOTE: PBS mem=50GB has no universally portable Flux directive in a batch script.
# Performance implication: without a memory request/limit, the job may be placed where less memory is available,
# increasing risk of OOM or contention.

# NOTE: PBS job name (-N MURbui) has no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none (metadata only), but job identification in monitoring/accounting may be less clear.

# NOTE: gpu_type=a100 was commented out in the input and therefore not requested.

module purge
module load ncarenv/22.12
module load nvhpc/22.11
module load cuda
module load craype
module load cray-mpich
module load ncarcompilers
module load cray-libsci
module list

make clean
make
'
"
}
